page.layout: One page of text, set full width. Below the text: the dedicatee's signature block ("T. Illustriß. D. D."), the closing word "addictissimus" in italic, and the author's name with title at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: gnus, semper tibi secundum Deum praestandi. Hunc, Illustrissima mater, oro, ut te & totam Britanniam vindicet,defendatq; ab omni malo, bonis omnibus instruat, bonum pacis stabiliat & firmet apud vos, mediante unćto[?] suo JACOBO PRIMO, Serenissimo & Augustissimo Rege, Defensore fidei Pio, Felice, cujus regnum idem rex regum justitiâ stabiliat,& folium æquitate,adeoq; omnia in vobis omnibus perficiat gratiosissimè, quæ sancta, justa, & salutaria sunt, ad laudem gratiæ & gloriæ suæ. Scripsi Herbornâ Nassoviorum, ex illustri Comitum nostrorum gratiosissimorum Scholâ, ubi Whitakeri vestri quædam scripta typis descripta sunt. Kal. April. anno Gratiæ MDCXII.

page.notes: The year is printed as a thousand sign (∞, a stylised M) followed by IↃC XII (DC XII); rendered as MDCXII. "unćto" is a doubtful reading, marked [?]. The printed "Profesfor" is given as "Professor". No page number is printed on this page.
